chapter: Highlights, the reunion album and fellow musicians
title: Highlights of his career
summary: He names Carnegie Hall, downtown theaters and his first France trip, and says he drew big crowds.

blocks.x: What do you consider to be the highlights of your career? I mean, as you look back on it, even though it's still going on, of course, and you know, you can't. But, I mean, just from where you are now, looking back on that portion of it that's already happened, what would you consider to be the highlights of your career?

Well, I played most of the big spots. I did a concert in Carnegie Hall. That was during the big band years which I, during the time when they had a paper called Pittsburgh Courier out at that time. That was one of the highlights. When I first went into, I was looking forward, I played the Apollo and all them now cause I loved that. But, I was looking forward to going downtown and playing the Paramount, the Strand and all that. And

when I got in it, that was a big, that was a
highlight.

And then when I, another thing
although I stayed away from Europe, but when I
went to France and the people seemed like they
had been waiting for me over there, although I
didn't have my big band, but I used the big band
that they had there. They had books out, record-
ing albums that I made through the years, and
this was my first trip there. And they came out
there with a book with my story in there, all
about me. And, you know, that made me feel good,
not being over there before. And then, I was
autographing it. I figure that's one spot, too.

And when I did the big band thing,
the place was just packed. You couldn't, people
standing around the sides, you know. Now, that
made me feel good.

But, I've played all over the states,
except for Hawaii and Alaska. I made them all.
And there, I've been treated very well during my
big band years. I really don't, I really don't
have nothing to say against the way they, people

I had played for. They made me feel good cause they came out in droves. They said I drew more than any big band out there during those years for dances. I won't say for theaters and all that, but for dances, we did draw very big through those years cause I did have records like 2 and 3 and 4 on all the vendors during that time when my records was very hot.
